title: Position Readiness Sprint and Manager Handbook
author: Maya Chen
content:
Summary
-------
This handbook defines the Position Readiness Sprint (PRS): a structured 2-week pre-boarding and 90-day ramp framework that shifts ownership of role activation from People Ops to hiring managers. The PRS reduces time-to-impact, standardizes manager responsibilities, and ensures consistent data capture for hiring and calibration.

Scope
-----
- Applies to all new full-time and contractor technical and product roles.
- Optional lightweight variant for customer success, sales, and corporate roles (see Related Templates).
- Excludes promotions/transfers within the first 90 days (use internal transfer checklist).

Desired outcomes and KPIs
------------------------
- Time-to-impact: target median = 45 days to first independent deliverable.
- Ramp completion rate: 85% of hires reach baseline competency by day 90.
- Manager compliance: 95% of PRS checklists completed within deadlines.
- Access SLA: 95% of accounts and tools provisioned by Day -1 (pre-boarding).

Roles & responsibilities
------------------------
- Hiring Manager (owner): lead PRS, create role-specific success criteria, run weekly check-ins, complete evaluation at 30/60/90 days.
- People Ops (enablement): run PRS templates, schedule orientation sessions, audit checklist completion, support calibration.
- New Hire Buddy: day‑to‑day onboarding partner for first 30 days.
- IT/Security: provision accounts, grant required access, confirm MFA and SSO.
- Hiring Panel/Team Lead: provide 1:1 shadow/knowledge transfer sessions in week 2–4.

Position Readiness Sprint (2-week pre-boarding) — step-by-step
------------------------------------------------------------
1) Initiate PRS (Immediately after offer accepted)
   - Manager opens PRS ticket in People Ops portal within 24 hours and attaches: role success criteria, 90-day deliverables, and preferred buddy.
   - People Ops sends pre-boarding checklist to hiring manager and new hire.

2) Week -2 to -1: Pre-boarding tasks (People Ops / IT SLA)
   - IT: create accounts, add to org groups, enable SSO, and verify MFA (SLA: 48 hours).
   - Manager: share first-week schedule and welcome doc; assign buddy; confirm equipment requests.
   - New Hire: complete HR forms, benefits enrollment, and security training module.

3) Day 0 — orientation and role kickoff
   - 90-minute orientation (People Ops): company mission, culture, policies, benefits, security.
   - Manager: 60-minute role kickoff covering success criteria, immediate deliverables, and team norms.
   - Buddy: schedule recurring micro-check-ins (15m) for first 30 days.

4) Week 1–4: Foundations and early deliverable
   - Manager sets a small, clear first deliverable due by day 30.
   - Weekly 1:1 focused on blockers and learning plan.
   - Week 2: shadow session with primary stakeholders.

5) Day 30 / Day 60 / Day 90 reviews (structured)
   - Manager completes templated evaluation and ratings against success criteria.
   - Calibration: People Ops aggregates results for hiring cohort review every 6 weeks.

90-day ramp plan (example table)
--------------------------------
| Period     | Focus                      | Manager actions                              | Measurement/Artifacts                     |
| Week 0     | Role setup & access        | Confirm tools, intro, assign buddy           | Access checklist complete                  |
| Week 1–4   | Learning + first deliverable| Weekly 1:1, pair programming, stakeholder intros | Deliverable demo, feedback notes          |
| Week 5–8   | Increasing autonomy        | Reduce pair work, assign independent tasks   | Code review independence, feature PRs     |
| Week 9–12  | Owner of feature area      | Handover small features, lead retro          | Completed project, manager sign-off       |

Manager Checklist (must-complete items)
--------------------------------------
- [ ] PRS ticket opened within 24h of offer acceptance.
- [ ] Role success criteria defined and shared.
- [ ] Buddy assigned and introduced by Day -1.
- [ ] First deliverable assigned and deadline set.
- [ ] Weekly 1:1 scheduled for 90 days.
- [ ] 30/60/90 evaluations submitted on schedule.

Templates and sample communications
----------------------------------
Sample pre-boarding email (send Day -10 to -3)
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — First steps and your week 0 schedule
Hi [Name],
Welcome — we’re excited to have you join as [Title]. Attached is your week 0 schedule, company handbook links, and a short welcome doc from your manager. Please complete the HR and security forms before Day 0.
Best,
[Manager name]

Sample 30-day manager evaluation snippet
"Has the new hire demonstrated the technical baseline required for independent contributions? 
- Evidence: PR merged with minimal revisions, stakeholder feedback attached."

Operational SLAs and tooling
---------------------------
- IT provisioning: create accounts + grant core tool access within 48 hours of PRS ticket.
- Equipment fulfillment: shipping within 5 business days after equipment request approval.
- PRS ticketing: People Ops will auto-remind managers at Day -7 and Day 0 if checklists are incomplete.
- Data capture: all PRS artifacts (evaluations, deliverables, feedback) stored in HRIS and linked to People Ops PRS ticket.

Measurement and continuous improvement
-------------------------------------
- People Ops runs monthly reports on: median time-to-impact, checklist compliance, and ramp completion rate.
- Quarterly retro: at least one hiring cohort retro per quarter to identify friction (tooling, slack channels, access issues).
- Experiment: alternate PRS with cohort onboarding once per quarter to measure signal on team cohesion.

Escalation path
---------------
1) Manager-level blocker: contact People Ops (prs-ops@redwood.ai) for exceptions.
2) Access/security blocker: open a Priority-1 ticket with IT, CC People Ops.
3) Performance concerns before Day 90: manager and People Ops schedule a check-in and follow progressive performance framework.

Manager success rubric (quick reference)
--------------------------------------
- Green: Completes all checklists, hires reach baseline by Day 60.
- Yellow: Minor checklist misses, hires meet baseline by Day 90 with support.
- Red: Multiple misses, hires do not meet baseline; triggers coaching and calibration with People Ops.

Appendices
---------
- Appendix A: PRS ticket template (copy into People Ops portal).
- Appendix B: Role success criteria examples (engineering, product, data).
- Appendix C: Links to learning resources and mandatory trainings.
